description: This file defines a utility class 'Log' that provides static methods for logging messages at various priority levels, wrapping around Android's native Log utilities. It manages chaining LogNode instances and offers convenience methods for different log levels.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for logging at various levels, encapsulating Android's native logging and managing a chain of LogNode instances.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode instance to send logs to.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Dispatches the log message to the current LogNode, specifying priority, tag, message, and optional throwable.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a verbose message with optional throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a debug message with optional throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an info message with optional throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warning message, overloads support with optional throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an error message with optional throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a severe assertion message, overloads support with optional throwable.
